title: Young Adults Fellowship Monthly Feedback
description: This survey is anonymous. Please share your honest feedback about the monthly fellowship. Your feedback will help us improve our fellowship, plan future activities, and identify opportunities to serve and reach others.

fields.name: attendance_experience
fields.label: How would you rate your overall fellowship experience this year?

fields.name: schedule_rating
fields.label: How do you feel about the current fellowship schedule and timing?

fields.name: schedule_feedback
fields.label: Is there anything about the timing or flow of the fellowship that you would change?

fields.name: prayer_feedback
fields.label: How meaningful have you found the prayer time during fellowship?

fields.name: testimony_feedback
fields.label: How do you feel about having an opportunity for people to share testimonies?
options: I would prefer a different format

fields.name: study_rating
fields.label: How would you rate the Bible study / teaching (Revelation)?

fields.name: study_suggestions
fields.label: Are there any specific Bible passages, topics, or questions you would like us to discuss?

fields.name: summer_activities
fields.label: How do you feel about having outdoor activities and sports during the summer?
options: I would prefer more fellowship/study time

fields.name: winter_activities
fields.label: What types of indoor activities would you like us to have during the winter? (multiple choices allowed)

fields.name: fellowship_connection
fields.label: Do you feel the fellowship is helping you build meaningful relationships with other young adults?

fields.name: fellowship_connection_suggestions
fields.label: What could we do to help people connect and get to know each other better?

fields.name: outreach_interest
fields.label: Would you be interested in helping plan or participate in outreach activities?
options: Yes, I would love to help
Maybe, I would like more information

fields.name: outreach_ideas
fields.label: What outreach activities do you think would work well for our young adults fellowship?

fields.name: outreach_suggestions
fields.label: If you have an outreach idea, please describe it. What could we do, who could we reach, or where could we serve?

fields.name: whatsapp_poll_feedback
fields.label: How do you feel about using WhatsApp polls to plan and organize fellowship?

fields.name: whatsapp_poll_feedback_text
fields.label: If you chose "I would prefer another method" can you let us know that. This will help decide it could be used to better organize?

fields.name: participation_barriers
fields.label: What makes it difficult for you to participate regularly in the Saturday morning prayer?

fields.name: next_prayer_attendance
fields.label: Would you be able to attend the prayer if we change it to another day? If so, can you mention your preference

fields.name: next_fellowship
fields.label: What is one thing you would like us to add, change, or improve for the next fellowship or going further?

fields.name: additional_feedback
fields.label: Is there anything else you would like the fellowship leaders to know?
